title: Japan Intercepts Chinese WZ-7 High-Altitude Drones Flying Through Miyako Strait
description: Chinese state media recently featured the WZ-7 alongside other PLA reconnaissance drones, describing the platforms as providing reconnaissance and targeting support to the PLA Army, Navy and Rocket Force. Japan reported on Nov. 2, 2026 that its air force intercepted once again China’s WZ-7 high-altitude reconnaissance jet drone as it was flying around Japanese airspace []

title: From Drones to Bomb Hoaxes: Is Europe’s Civil Aviation Facing a New Form of Hybrid Warfare?
description: A wave of false bomb threats has triggered flight diversions, emergency procedures and fighter jet scrambles across Europe, raising questions about a possible new tactic aimed at disrupting civilian aviation. title: Israeli defense company says this trigger is programmed to shoot drones
description: The company says the Arbel electromechanical device will release a cadence of fire optimized for shooting down drones.

title: Bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life through music
description: In this edition of Entre Nous, we meet Timothy Henty, the British conductor bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life in Paris. As part of the Harry Potter Film Concert Series, he leads more than 80 musicians in a spectacular live orchestral performance, offering audiences a unique opportunity to experience one of cinema's most beloved stories like never before.

title: British comedian Russell Brand found guilty of rape, sexual assault
description: A London jury on Thursday convicted British comedian and actor Russell Brand of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

title: South African star Zolani Mahola: From 'Waka Waka' with Shakira to 'People Power'
description: From the global success of "Waka Waka" to her forthcoming second solo album "People Power", South Africa's Zolani Mahola has built a career around the power of music to bring people together.

title: Bent on leaving his mark: Trump's proposed 'Triumphal Arch' sparks backlash
description: Since his return to power, US President Donald Trump has been intent on reshaping the nation's capital Washington, seeking to leave his name and mark on it. After his involvement with the Kennedy Center, the White House ballroom and the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, Trump is now particularly keen on building a 250-foot (79-metre) "Triumphal Arch" – a project he claims is intended to honour the 250th anniversary of the United States.

title: Navi Pillay: Fighting violence with justice
description: From the International Criminal Court to Africa’s place in the global justice system, the stakes are high. In an exclusive interview, Nobel Peace Prize winner, Navi Pillay will discuss international justice . She says it it must not be held hostage to political power, as Donald Trump targets the ICC. What does this showdown mean for Africa?

title: US midterms: 'Donald Trump's wings have been more than clipped'
description: US President Donald Trump faced a radically transformed and hostile political landscape after Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and the Senate in Tuesday's (November 3) midterms. The result was a personal humiliation for the 80-year-old Trump, leaving him as a lame duck president for the remaining two years of his term. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

title: Europe: Dozens of flights diverted following bomb threats
description: Hoax bomb threats hit at least 27 affected flights around Europe this week.

title: 'Identity crisis': Can Democrats 'deliver' following their 'historic', once in a generation victory?
description: A historic Democratic electoral breakthrough has transformed the American political landscape. For Laurie Dundon, Senior Associate Fellow at the European Leadership Network and former US diplomat, the central question is whether the Democratic Party can convert electoral momentum into coherent governance. title: Israel's Arab list backs Eisenkot as Netanyahu loses ultra-Orthodox support
description: Israel's largest Arab party grouping said Thursday it would recommend opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, potentially bolstering his bid after Arab-majority lists won a record 19 seats in last week's election and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu lost the support of an allied religious party.

title: Burning rubbish chokes besieged Yemeni city of Taiz
description: Taiz residents face health risks as waste accumulates amid sniper fire, forcing people to burn it in the streets.

title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault by UK court
description: British comedian was convicted by jury at London court of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

title: ‘Healthcare not bombs’: How Gaza shaped Adam Hamawy’s path to US Congress
description: Former army surgeon and Gaza volunteer Hamawy is the first Muslim American elected to the US Congress from New Jersey.

title: Could the US midterms further isolate Israel in Washington?
description: The midterms showed that challenging support for Israel can win votes. But changing US foreign policy may be harder.

description: Israel’s president consults party leaders on forming a government, as Israeli forces attack Palestinians in Gaza.

title: Ronaldo in records: International milestones from the football icon
description: Ronaldo, 41, ended an illustrious 23-year career that spanned six World Cups and six European Championships.

title: Why Guinea-Bissau halted a controversial hepatitis vaccine trial for babies
description: Experts have said the US-funded trial would deny critical vaccines to thousands of infants.

description: Mojtaba Khamenei’s consultations suggest a new system of decision-making is taking shape.

description: The final of Gaza’s ‘Thousand Martyrs’ Cup marks the return of organised football after nearly three years of war.

title: Photos: Thousands rally in France over rising costs and economic struggles
description: Trade unions led more than 260 planned protests nationwide, urging government to address economic woes and wage demands.

title: Everyone’s Talking About the ‘Blue Tsunami.’ In Japan, It’s Complicated.
description: The New York Post used a Hokusai work to depict Donald Trump being swept away by Democrats’ midterm election win. Some in Japan were bothered by the imagery.

title: Finland Sends 2 Men to Prison for Damaging Undersea Cable in Baltic Sea
description: A Finnish court convicted the captain and boatswain of a cargo ship of aggravated criminal damage in relation to an incident last year in the Gulf of Finland.

title: What to Know About the Bomb Threats Disrupting Flights in Europe
description: More than a dozen planes that were targeted on Thursday landed safely, officials said, after similar threats earlier this week. The hoaxes have added to airspace anxiety in the region.
